benchmarks: Codebooks; Simple Reversals; Semantic Structure; Latent Gridworld (pixel RL & ASCII BC)
cita: Lampinen et al. (2025). Latent learning: episodic memory complements parametric learning by enabling flexible reuse of experiences.
notes: §4 Benchmarks + §6 Results (Fig.3-4): baseline (parametric-only) transformer fails near-chance on latent-learning test conditions (Codebooks/Simple Reversals) despite passing component tasks; adding "oracle retrieval" of the relevant past episode (prepended to context, 3-7 candidates incl. distractors, §Methods) resolves the failure (Fig.4). Retrieval is an ORACLE (ground-truth relevant episode is given, not computed) -> not a ranking/embedding/grep algorithm -> retrieval=NA. No memory-specific failure modes (staleness/poisoning) discussed -> fallos_mitigaciones=NINGUNO. §6 also extends to Semantic-structure (syllogisms/category-inclusion) and Latent-Gridworld (RL+BC) benchmarks, all showing retrieval>baseline.

fallos_mitigaciones: Uncontrolled memory growth / context contamination from redundant near-duplicate task entries; mitigated via similarity-threshold consolidation that has the LLM synthesize overlapping entries into one representative entry and removes the originals (§3.3).
cita: Shen and Joung (2026). TALM: Dynamic Tree-Structured Multi-Agent Framework with Long-Term Memory for Scalable Code Generation.
notes: §3.3 mechanism: vector-DB LTM stores task histories (problem desc./reasoning/code/tree-depth metadata); write gated on validation passing (ADMISION); consolidation merges entries above a similarity threshold via LLM synthesis and removes originals (CONSOLIDACION+OLVIDO) -- paper states two different threshold values for this (0.95 in §3.3 mechanism text vs 0.75 in §4.1.3 hyperparameters), both anchored as-is. Table 1 (§4.3.1) ablates "TALM without memory" vs "with memory": GPT-4o-mini ClassEval testcase-level 77.85%->80.72%, BigCodeBench 46.32%->47.10%; GPT-4o ClassEval 84.65%->86.79%. Table 2 (§4.3.2) ablates localized re-reasoning (drops 1.2-2.7pp across datasets). §4.2.2/Fig.4: TALM uses far fewer tokens than MapCoder baseline; agents shared across the tree query the same LTM module (multiagente=SI).

benchmarks: Custom text-based generative-agent simulation (Park et al. 2023-style Smallville, 8 agents x 3 days x 16h)
cita: Hong and He (2025). Enhancing memory retrieval in generative agents through LLM-trained cross attention networks.
notes: §3.1-3.3: ACAN = auxiliary cross-attention network trained with LLM-scored comparisons vs a Weighted-Memory-Retrieval (WMR: recency-decay 0.995/hr + LLM-importance + cosine-relevance via text-embedding-ada-002) baseline; agents store experiences/actions/observations to memory bank after every action (WRITE, deterministic per-action event). §4.1 Results: ACAN avg retrieval-quality score (LLM-judged 1-10) 5.94(sd1.66) vs WMR baseline 5.05(sd1.88), T=7.44, p=2.42e-13. Memory is explicitly described as "private" per agent (Intro) despite the 8-agent simulation -> multiagente=NO. No provenance/staleness mechanism beyond WMR's own recency-decay scoring term.

cita: Zhang et al. (2025). Bridging Intuitive Associations and Deliberate Recall: Empowering LLM Personal Assistant with Graph-Structured Long-term Memory.
notes: §4.1 event-centric personal memory graph, explicit "Hybrid utterance-graph storage" preserving edges to raw utterances (HIBRIDA); §4.1 graph dedup via FAISS-incremental merge + agglomerative clustering (CONSOLIDACION, triggered "as new memories are added"). §4.2 Collaborative retrieval: Intuitive Association = PCST subgraph over query-embedding-scored node/edge prizes (EMBEDDINGS+GRAFO); Deliberating Recall = iterative query augmentation via fine-tuned Qwen-2.5-3B; §4.2.3 personalized-PageRank evidence ranking (RANKING). §5.3 Table1: retrieval recall@5/10, ndcg@5/10 beat BM25/Contriever/Stella/BGE/LongMemEval baselines. §5.5 Table3: 4-way ablation (w/o AM, DM, SFT, EIR) -- AM removal = largest drop.

fallos_mitigaciones: Performance declines beyond session 5 / >60 dialogue turns due to noise from lengthy retrieved history (over-retention-like degradation, §4.2); mitigated via topic-shift-detector discarding off-topic short-term utterances and Conversation-Edit-Distance re-ranking that preserves dialogue structure (§2.2).
cita: Liu et al. (2025). A Persona-Aware LLM-Enhanced Framework for Multi-Session Personalized Dialogue Generation.
notes: §2.2 topic-aware memory bank: DPR dense retrieval (EMBEDDINGS) of long-term history + Conversation-Edit-Distance re-rank (RANKING) + topic-shift-detector discards off-topic short-term utterances (ADMISION). §2.3 persona commonsense-KG (PeaCoK) + query-driven GNN (GRAFO) contributes SEMANTICA content. §2.4 VAE-LoRA injects latent query/response info via a LoRA adapter (PARAMETRICA, ACTUALIZACION of model params). §4.4 Table4 ablation of the 3 modules (topic memory bank / persona prompt learning / VAE-LoRA), all positive contributions. §4.2 Table2: degradation beyond session 5 (>60 turns) from history noise.

benchmarks: MultiWOZ-Long (adapted from MultiWOZ 2.2); DialogRE-L (adapted from DialogRE)
fallos_mitigaciones: Coreference-resolution errors (27% of failures) and dependency-parsing errors (19%) are the dominant causes of wrong/missed memory retrieval; discourse mislabeling (15%) mostly from sarcasm/overlapping speech (§5.6 Table4, consistent with the ablation §5.3). No explicit mitigation given beyond flagging these as open challenges.
cita: Chatterjee and Agarwal (2025). Semantic Anchoring in Agentic Memory: Leveraging Linguistic Structures for Persistent Conversational Context.
notes: §3.2-3.4: hybrid memory entry Mi=(utterance,coref-entities,dep-parse,discourse-tags,dense-embedding); hybrid dense(FAISS)+symbolic(inverted-index) retrieval fused by a weighted score (EMBEDDINGS + symbolic exact-key lookup ~GREP-ARCHIVOS + RANKING fusion). §3.5: "memory manager...determines whether to store...update an existing entry (e.g., revised facts), or discard low-value information" -> WRITE/ACTUALIZACION/ADMISION named but the trigger mechanism itself is never detailed elsewhere -> trigger=NA; update-on-revised-facts = staleness handling -> fidelidad_procedencia=SI. §5.1 Table1 MultiWOZ-Long: FR 54.1->83.5%, DC 48.3->80.8%, UCS 2.1->4.3 (Stateless->Semantic-Anchoring); §5.3 Table3 ablation: -discourse tagging drops FR 4.7pts, -coref drops DC 6.2pts, all-symbolic-removed = Vector-RAG level. §4.4/App.A.8: retrieval latency ~120ms dense+~40ms symbolic+~15ms fusion.
